description: Use this when someone asks what a planet in a house means in Vedic astrology, e.g. "Venus in the 8th house", "Saturn in 12th house meaning", "Sun in my 12th house". Use this instead of vedic_birth_chart when the person names a planet and a house, even in the first person ("my Venus is in my 8th"); do not ask for birth details. Returns what the house holds, what the planet brings, and our article when one exists. None of these tools cover daily horoscopes, gemstones, tarot or predictions.
name: planet_in_house_meaning
title: Planet in a house (Vedic meaning)
